sql: WITH overall_median AS (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY comp_mid_usd) AS overall_median_pay FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL) SELECT seniority, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay_remote_us, (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY comp_mid_usd) - (SELECT overall_median_pay FROM overall_median)) AS diff_from_overall_median FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY seniority ORDER BY seniority
